title: Task specification
acceptance_check: Success cannot be awarded solely by the evaluated agent’s self-report.
source_implementation: Define prerequisites, permitted tools, expected artifacts and prohibited effects independently of the tested skill.
source_prerequisites: Maintainer-approved tasks; M3; synthetic repository/org fixtures.
coverage: Versioned skill and host values required with sf test execution provenance.
blocker: Real coding-host runs, actual skill version artifacts, broader task outcomes, independent qualification workloads and native org execution remain pending.

title: Host adapters
acceptance_check: Adapter reports actual available capabilities and unsupported controls.
source_implementation: Run the same task through two selected coding hosts in isolated environments.
source_prerequisites: R01; host/API access; license/cost allowance; D6.
coverage: Distinct repeat execution IDs and nonempty native-shaped test arrays verified.
blocker: Real coding-host runs, actual skill version artifacts, broader task outcomes, independent qualification workloads and native org execution remain pending.

title: Outcome verification

source_prerequisites: R02; D2 when live; reset fixtures; independent assertions.

title: Repeated comparisons
